label: D1: rewarded in S2, about to repeat a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1. Within that it is almost entirely restricted to trials where the previous trial reached S2 (prev_state is 2, or unknown on the window first trial) and the agent then chooses a2 (stay). Its policy logit at D1 sits in a moderately a2-leaning range (choice -4.4 to -1.5, which holds 97% of the mass). It never fires at GO or D2, on unrewarded D1 steps, or after reward in S1. The predicate uses the upcoming action, which the agent computes itself; without it (reward after S2 only) F1 drops from 0.61 to 0.51. Recall and mass recall are about 1.0 but precision is only about 0.44. Many qualifying steps stay silent, especially late in the episode (rate falls sharply after trial 60; adding ep_trial<60 raises dev F1 to 0.75 but costs 25% of the mass). Magnitude: the largest activations (about 1.0) are the first reward after an unrewarded trial. Repeated consecutive rewards give small activations (about 0.02-0.06). Predicate prev trial unrewarded holds 76% of the top quartile versus 1-2% of the bottom two quartiles. So it acts like a newly-rewarded-at-S2, keep-choosing-a2 signal.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: in_rew=1 (+3.95), phase=D1 & before=a1 S1 u (+2.61), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 3 (9 = most a1) (+2.50), phase=D1 & last=a2 S2 r (+2.41), last=a2 S2 r (+2.34), choice_bin=decile 3 (9 = most a1) (+2.05). Lower it: in_rew=0 (-7.14), action=1 (-5.86), prev_state=1 (-5.53), stay=1 (-4.61).
